newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues up, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 476,000 barrels in the week ended October 2 to 10.213 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks fell 295,000 barrels to 8.120 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks also rose by 255,000 barrels to 6.339 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
